question: Are there any trees or shrubs shown within 10 feet of the transformer pads shown on the electrical plan (Sheet 21)? If yes, what species are shown and are they identified as utility-compatible?
checklistItemText: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment are not identified as utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F, or trees within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductors are not utility-compatible
classifierReasoning: The agent is asking for a distance measurement between trees/shrubs and transformer pads (10-foot lateral clearance), which is the core spatial verification needed to determine compliance with the checklist requirement, even though species identification is a secondary follow-up.
